name: launcher
title: Launcher
tagline: Type  l <name>  to launch any game or app
description: Terminal command: l <name of game/app> finds the .elf and runs it.
long: Adds the terminal command l (aliases: launch, launcher). Type l snake and Launcher finds the matching .elf by itself: it checks <folder>/<name>.elf, then a folder called <name> (whatever .elf is inside), then any file or folder whose name contains what you typed. Searches the games and apps folders and your home folder. Nothing is hardcoded per app.
